name: CTA Runoff
content:
EXAM:CTA Abdomen/Pelvis with runoff

TECHNIQUE: CTA of the abdomen and pelvis with bilateral extremity runoff was performed with IV contrast. Oral contrast not administered. CT scan done according to ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable.)
 

COMPARISON: None

GI Contrast: None

 VASCULAR FINDINGS:

 The celiac,  superior mesenteric artery, inferior mesenteric artery are patent.
  Bilateral renal arteries are patent.
  There is normal branch pattern.
  No abdominal aortic aneurysm or dissection.
  No aortoiliac disease.
  Patent common, bilateral iliac, external and internal iliac arteries.
  Patent bilateral common femoral arteries and proximal superficial and profundus arteries.


 NONVASCULAR FINDINGS: 

LUNG BASES: [Unremarkable.] 

LIVER: [Unremarkable.]

GALLBLADDER: [Unremarkable.]

SPLEEN: [Unremarkable.] 

KIDNEYS: [Unremarkable.]

ADRENALS: [Unremarkable.]

PANCREAS: [Unremarkable.]

BOWEL: [Unremarkable.] 

ABDOMINAL/PELVIC WALL: [Unremarkable.]

BLADDER:  [Unremarkable.]

PLEVIS/REPRODUCTIVE: [Unremarkable]

FLUID: [Unremarkable.]

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:  [Unremarkable.]
